location: README.md install and update verification; docs/releasing.md post-install verification
oracle: qa-suite/references/agents/deployment-qa.md artifact identity requirements; qa-context.md candidate identity check; README.md install and update contract; docs/releasing.md exact-ref artifact contract

repro_steps: Compare the released v1.4.0 and candidate VERSION values and qa-suite Git tree identities.
Run the documented Codex plugin listing check.
Compare the existing installed cache with the candidate artifact without changing plugin state.
Inspect the Claude Code update procedure for a post-restart exact-content check.
defect_record.expected_result: Post-install verification binds the active plugin payload to the requested immutable release tag, commit, or artifact digest.
defect_record.actual_result: The released v1.4.0 tree and candidate tree both report version 1.4.0 while their qa-suite tree identities differ. The documented Codex check reports installed state and version but not the active tree identity, and the Claude Code procedure defines no post-restart exact-content check.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef on macOS; existing Codex cache inspected read-only; no install or upgrade executed.

location: README.md install and update procedures; docs/releasing.md publication and recovery procedure
oracle: qa-suite/references/agents/deployment-qa.md rollback identity requirements; README.md install and update contract; docs/releasing.md release procedure

repro_steps: Read the documented install and update commands for every delivery channel.
Read the fresh-install and release-workflow recovery procedure.
Search the declared contracts for a consumer downgrade or rollback selector and post-rollback identity check.
defect_record.expected_result: A documented consumer rollback selects a known prior immutable plugin payload, restores it, and verifies that exact prior identity.
defect_record.actual_result: The contracts define install, update, current-marketplace reinstall, and release-workflow recovery, but no consumer rollback to a prior payload for Codex, Claude Code, Claude.ai, or local-skill installs.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef; static inspection of public install and release contracts; no disposable target or rollback execution.

repro_steps: Load the version-2 finding-ledger schema.
Construct two valid in-memory rows with different IDs and candidate identities.
Assign both rows the same report pointer.
Call validateFindingRows on both rows.
defect_record.expected_result: Validation rejects one report pointer that identifies different candidate cycles.
defect_record.actual_result: Validation accepted both rows because report-pointer uniqueness is enforced only within each row and no ledger-wide pointer-to-candidate binding is checked.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef; Node.js in-memory validator probe; no persistent store created.

repro_steps: Configure a repository-relative ledger path whose existing parent is a directory symlink.
Inspect initializeLedger before its mkdir and open operations.
Compare the ledger initializer with the registry initializer's pre-write canonical-parent check.
defect_record.expected_result: Initialization rejects an escaping canonical parent before creating any directory or ledger file.
defect_record.actual_result: The ledger initializer performs only a lexical path check before mkdir and open, then canonicalizes the created file. A symlinked parent can redirect zero-byte file creation outside the repository before the escape is rejected.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 2dd3392f2382fac2d71387ea55ce004283b3ddef; static control-flow evidence; no disposable target and no file-creation probe executed.

location: README.md Usage command wrappers and Claude Code 2.1.220 installed-plugin command resolution
oracle: README.md current usage contract; qa-context.md core flow 5; installed Claude plugin command namespace behavior

repro_steps: Create a fresh Claude configuration root and disposable consumer project.
Install qa-suite@qa-suite from the pinned v1.5.0 repository marketplace.
Confirm the plugin is enabled and verify its active qa-suite tree against the candidate archive.
Run the README-documented /qa-smoke, /qa-regression, and /qa-release commands in Claude Code print mode.
Run the corresponding /qa-suite:qa-smoke, /qa-suite:qa-regression, and /qa-suite:qa-release forms as resolution controls.
defect_record.expected_result: Each command named by the README resolves to its installed wrapper and starts the declared QA path, or a resolution failure gives a runnable recovery step.
defect_record.actual_result: All three unqualified commands returned Unknown command. All three namespaced forms passed command resolution and then stopped at the expected fresh-root authentication boundary; the unknown-command state did not name the required namespace.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 00c18a31fa46ddec9edb5c7f6d9e07a13ab588d7 on macOS; Claude Code 2.1.220; isolated user-scope v1.5.0 installation with exact payload verification; no model turn executed.

location: qa-context.md and repository release full-suite commands when retained test-bearing evidence exists under QA/
oracle: qa-context.md test command; WORKFLOW.md and AGENTS.md repository verification contracts

repro_steps: Use the frozen candidate checkout with retained QA evidence that contains copied tests below QA/.
Run node --test from the repository root.
Observe whether nested QA paths are discovered and whether the command exits nonzero.
Run the explicitly scoped tracked-root test command as a control.
defect_record.expected_result: The authoritative full-suite command runs the repository test suite successfully without treating retained QA evidence as additional project tests.
defect_record.actual_result: The bare command recursively discovered test-bearing copies below ignored QA/, executed 2899 tests, and failed 11 in an unrestricted rerun. The explicitly scoped tracked root suite passed 366 non-skipped tests with no failures.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 00c18a31fa46ddec9edb5c7f6d9e07a13ab588d7 on macOS; Node.js 26.5.0; checkout populated with ignored QA evidence; loopback permitted for the confirming discovery rerun.

location: qa-suite/references/agents/deployment-qa.md and docs/releasing.md Claude agent reachability classification
oracle: Deployment evidence hierarchy: strict validation, debug registration, unknown-agent inventory control, and known-agent name resolution

repro_steps: Strictly validate the v1.5.0 Claude plugin and marketplace metadata.
Install the candidate into an isolated Claude Code 2.1.220 configuration root.
Compare claude plugin details agent inventory with debug registration output.
Run an unknown-agent control to enumerate registered names.
Run one known qa-suite agent and observe whether name resolution reaches the pre-execution authentication boundary.
Compare the available evidence with the deployment lane's outage classification.
defect_record.expected_result: Deployment QA uses independent registration and name-resolution evidence for reachability, treats component inventory as diagnostic rather than conclusive, and retains a contradictory inventory display as a host compatibility limitation instead of a product outage.
defect_record.actual_result: The release rehearsal treated claude plugin details reporting Agents (0) as sole proof that the agent flows were unavailable and proposed an S1 outage. Controlled validation, debug registration of all 11 agents, exact-name enumeration, and known-agent resolution showed the runtime paths were reachable despite the inventory display.
defect_record.environment: Candidate 00c18a31fa46ddec9edb5c7f6d9e07a13ab588d7 on macOS; Claude Code 2.1.220; isolated plugin layouts; name resolution stopped at the expected authentication boundary without a model call.
